text_block_list.text:
Spring—the season of the Classics has
arrived. I
draft a plan of what races we'll
take on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
One day, we watch some videos of races

featuring Triple Crown champion Narita
Brian.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While watching Нарита Брайан race, I think
about
how unfortunate it is that Mayano
Top Gun
doesn't have such a rival.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I can't stop watching the
videos of
Нарита Брайан. Маяно Топ Ган
becomes jealous
and yells at me to keep
my eyes on her and her
alone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She then sets a goal of defeating Narita
Brian in a
legitimate race with the
apparent intention of
keeping my
attention all for herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
